title: Schema Model Bucket
description: Bucketing configuration for the materialized table. Accepts a single { column, count } object or an array of them. On Iceberg, each entry is emitted as a bucket(column, count) transform inside `partitioning`. On Hive / Glue, columns are emitted as `bucketed_by` with a single shared `bucket_count` (all entries must share the same count). Not supported on Delta Lake in dbt-trino.
markdownDescription:
**`bucket`** — hash-bucket table data by one or more columns.

- **Iceberg:** each entry becomes a `bucket(column, count)` transform appended to `partitioning`; counts may differ per column.
- **Hive / Glue:** emitted as `bucketed_by = ARRAY[...]` with a single `bucket_count`; all entries must share the same `count`.
- **Delta Lake:** not supported by the dbt-trino Delta connector — DJ surfaces a Problems-tab error.

The bucket column must be one of the model's columns.

bucketSpec.title: Bucket Spec
bucketSpec.description: A single bucketing column and its bucket count.

count.description: Number of hash buckets to distribute the column's values across.
